recorded_before: Any calculation in this folder. Already known beforehand: the live-fund report (calendar returns 2020-2026 for SPMO, SPY, GLD, AMOM; 2019-05 to 2026-10 windows). Everything here is development evidence, not a holdout.
purpose: Diagnose why SPMO's apparent lead over SPY and gold clusters after 2023, before building or promoting anything. Frozen live-fund results are not modified.

questions.Q1_time_concentration: Share of SPMO's cumulative log excess return (vs SPY and vs GLD) earned from 2024-01-01 onward, over SPMO's full live history (first close 2015-10-12 to 2026-10-16) and the common 2019-05-22 start. Calendar-year and non-overlapping two-year blocks; relative drawdown of the SPMO/benchmark ratio (depth, longest time below a prior relative high); monthly excess mean with Newey-West (6 lags) t-statistic, full and excluding 2024 onward. MTUM shown as a second, independent momentum implementation.
questions.Q2_factor_and_control_attribution: Monthly SPMO excess over the risk-free rate regressed on Fama-French 5 factors plus momentum (Kenneth French data library, US), full sample, before 2024 and 2024 onward. Separately, SPMO minus SPY regressed on SPYG minus SPY, QQQ minus SPY and RSP minus SPY. Report buy-and-hold results for these simple controls on identical dates and costs.
questions.Q3_holdings_attribution: Point-in-time quarterly holdings from SEC N-PORT filings for SPMO (series S000050154) and IVV (series S000004310, S&P 500 proxy for SPY weights). Each quarter-end weight held for the following quarter; stock returns from Yahoo adjusted closes. Report holdings-implied vs actual SPMO return (fidelity residual), active contribution per stock, top-k concentration, 2024-onward active return with the top 1/3/5/10 contributors' active contribution removed, holding-count/top-10 weight, and sector active contribution (current Yahoo sector labels; historical GICS not available).
questions.Q4_long_history_base_rate: Kenneth French '6 Portfolios Formed on Size and Momentum (2x3)', value-weighted Big/High-prior portfolio versus the market (Mkt-RF + RF), monthly since 1927: calendar-year win rate, decade blocks, longest relative drawdown, and the same figures after 1% and 2% annual cost drags. Gross academic returns, monthly rebalanced; a base-rate check for long-only large-cap momentum, not SPMO's rules.

hurdle_note: The 3 percentage-point annual hurdle is the earlier research convention, retained for comparability; it is not a user-agreed guarantee.

reject_if_any: R1: at least 75% of SPMO's full-live-history cumulative log excess over SPY comes from 2024 onward AND annualized excess over SPY before 2024 is below +1 percentage point.
R2: removing the active contribution of the top 5 contributing stocks leaves SPMO's 2024-onward annualized holdings-implied active return over IVV below 3 percentage points.
R3: SPYG or QQQ buy-and-hold matches or beats SPMO within 1 percentage point annualized over SPMO's full live history, with no deeper daily-close drawdown.
decision_rule.continue_only_if: No rejection rule triggers AND the long-history base rate (Q4, after a 1% cost drag) shows long-only large-cap momentum beating the market by at least 1 percentage point annualized in a majority of non-overlapping decades. Even then the outcome is only permission to freeze one cash-only candidate for a prospective test, not promotion.
decision_rule.not_allowed: No regime switch, timing overlay, parameter search or fund substitution added after seeing these diagnostics.

costs: Fund comparisons: 0.10% entry and 0.10% exit, as in the live-fund protocol. Academic portfolios: gross plus stated drags.
data_cutoff: Prices end 2026-10-16 (end_exclusive 2026-10-17). New tickers SPYG, QQQ, RSP, IVV, XLK are a new download for this experiment; existing data/live_funds files are reused unchanged.
limits: Quarterly holdings miss intra-quarter rebalances (SPMO rebalances in March and September). Yahoo may lack delisted stocks; missing names are reported, not filled. Current sector labels are applied to past holdings. No tax, FX or Romanian execution modeled.
